title: Agents screen catalogue, filters and comparison

claims.text: The screen module mounts the Agents catalogue with a read helper that caps responses at 1048576 bytes, validates JSON, and raises TransportError on domain refusal.
The toolbar exposes filter controls for query, workflow, language, status, retired inclusion and sort, plus create, compare and clear-comparison actions.
The compare action opens openComparison only when exactly two agents are selected and no identity collision is present.
The creation workflow wires createWorkflow with the confirmed head, read, refresh and announce hooks, and the score panel renders scoreResult groups.

decision.rule: Change here when the Agents catalogue layout, its filters, comparison selection or creation flow needs to change.
decision.failure: The list fails to load, comparison opens with the wrong selection size, or creation does not refresh after commit.

questions.q: Where does the Agents screen read the agent list and cap its size?
